eligibility_blockers: An audit of prior use of 2026 observations must clear the year before calling it an independent test.
The full June-September 2026 forecast-only corpus, IMD 03-03 UTC reference, and model-version comparability must pass source and QC gates.
forecast_features: Frozen 22-column forecast-only Track B pipeline with no valid-time observations or reanalysis
reference: Locally held IMD 0.25-degree daily rainfall aligned to 03-03 UTC; no replacement by IMERG
grid_and_mask: Existing regional 49x49 grid; only paired cells with both forecast and IMD reference valid; no missing cell filled as zero
primary_regime_comparison: M4_soft_regime minus M2_global_XGBoost heavy-rain CSI on exactly paired eligible cell-days
secondary_regime_comparison: M3_hard_regime minus M2_global_XGBoost heavy-rain CSI on the same cells

promotion_gate.heavy_CSI_adjustment: Bonferroni family of two regime comparisons; two-sided 97.5-percent initialization-date block-bootstrap interval; M4 lower bound must be greater than zero
promotion_gate.if_any_gate_fails: Keep M2 as the product default and publish the null or adverse result

bootstrap.unit: UTC initialization date; all leads and spatial cells stay in the date block

probability_rule: Use frozen 2024-fitted calibrators without refitting. Require very-heavy probability not to exceed heavy probability. Report 2026 reliability only after observations arrive; no warning threshold is reselected on 2026.
prohibited: No model, threshold, bias shift, QC tolerance, mask, or metric selection based on 2026 observations.
No pooling with GEFSv12 reforecast Track A.
No public or official warning claim from this research evaluation.
